remarks:
Enjoy the best of country living with the convenience of nearby everyday amenities at this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath ranch home set on 10 acres.

Surrounded by the peacefulness and natural beauty of the countryside, this property offers plenty of space to enjoy the outdoors while remaining conveniently located near groceries, schools, and a variety of local entertainment and amenities.

Inside, the home offers a comfortable and functional layout with two bedrooms, a full bathroom, and an enclosed sunroom that adds a wonderful bonus space to enjoy year-round. New luxury vinyl flooring flows throughout the home, creating a fresh, updated feel while offering easy maintenance.

The kitchen features newer lower cabinets and countertops along with a newer oven, bringing practical updates to the heart of the home.

Outside, 10 acres of possibilities await. A large, partially fenced side yard provides defined outdoor space, while the remaining acreage offers room to explore, enjoy nature, garden, or simply take in the peaceful country surroundings.

An attached two-car garage adds everyday convenience and valuable storage.

A new septic system installed in 2022 adds peace of mind.

Whether you're looking for more room to spread out, a quieter setting, or simply the opportunity to enjoy the beauty of owning acreage, this property offers a wonderful blend of comfort, updates, privacy, and convenience.

Come experience the possibilities of country living on 10 acres!
